name: Chapman Pharmacy Summer Research Program for High School Students
what_you_do: Join a small group of 3 to 5 students. Work with a faculty advisor on a pharmacy research project. You use lab tools, write a report and present your results.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 in the fall after the program. A 3.0 GPA or higher is suggested. You should like research or health science.
pay_detail: The page lists the total cost for 2025 as $1,503. It does not list a 2026 price. Cost covers lab access, food on in-person days and materials.
duration: 3 weeks. In 2026 it ran July 13 to July 31.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full. The page offers a waitlist. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: For a waitlist spot, email the program director, Dr. Hamid Montazeri, using the contact on the program page. Watch the page for the next registration.
notes: You get a certificate of completion and can ask for a letter of reference. Sessions are online and in person. The page lists a full refund if you cancel by June 29, 2026.
